predictions.articleTitle: AS Montigny-lès-Metz vs CA Pontarlier Prediction & Match Analysis: Can R3 Hosts Breach N2 Defense?
predictions.coreRecommendation: CA Pontarlier's four-tier National 2 defensive quality and clean-sheet road form favor an away win or regulation stalemate in a low-scoring seventh-round tie.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win led by CA Pontarlier's fourth-tier class and 0.71 league goals-conceded rate, while retaining the 90-minute draw due to their 4-of-7 league stalemate trend (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 Goals backed by the 60.9% Poisson under projection from lambda_total 2.25 and Pontarlier's disciplined away defensive structure (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Unbeaten National 2 defense meets Régional 3 hosts on relocated Metz turf.

spf.comment: Covers both Pontarlier's dominant 0:2 fourth-tier away-win script and the 1:1 stalemate risk created by their 4-of-7 league draw rate, where a single call would ignore documented cup resistance.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 60.9% Poisson probability at lambda_total 2.25 and Pontarlier allowing just five goals across seven National 2 matches.

score.comment: 0:2 reflects Pontarlier's clean-sheet away wins at Is-Selongey and Jura Dolois, while 1:1 mirrors the 13.3% modal Poisson scoreline and Montigny's sixth-round draw.

goals.comment: Matches the top two Poisson goal densities (26.7% for 2 goals, 23.7% for 1 goal) in a controlled knockout matchup.

bqc.comment: Anticipates first-half resistance from Montigny's compact block before Pontarlier either break through late as at Valdahon-Vercel or settle for a 90-minute draw.
